gloss: to retake; to reshoot; to take again

definitions.gloss: to retake; to reshoot; to photograph again
definitions.explanation: To take a photo or shoot a video again, usually because the first attempt was unsatisfactory.

examples.japanese: ⟦{写真|しゃしん}→写真：00753_shashin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{撮|と}り{直|なお}した。
⟦ぶれていた→ぶれる：10522_bureru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦もう→もう：00602_mou⟧⟦{一枚|いちまい}→一枚：08889_ichimai⟧{撮|と}り{直|なお}して⟦もらえます→もらう：00520_morau⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: It was blurry, so could you retake it?

examples.japanese: ⟦{監督|かんとく}→監督：00185_kantoku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{納得|なっとく}→納得：03507_nattoku⟧がいかず、⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦シーン→シーン：08914_shiin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{何度|なんど}→何度：17592_nando⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{撮|と}り{直|なお}した。
examples.english: The director wasn't satisfied and reshot that scene many times.

notes:
Compound verb from ⟦{撮|と}る→撮る：00760_toru⟧ (to take/photograph) + {直|なお}す (to redo; to fix). The {直|なお}す auxiliary pattern is productive: ⟦{書|か}き{直|なお}す→書き直す：04597_kakinaosu⟧ (rewrite), ⟦{作|つく}り{直|なお}す→作り直す：20924_tsukurinaosu⟧ (remake), ⟦やり{直|なお}す→やり直す：03172_yarinaosu⟧ (redo). Very common in everyday situations — asking someone to retake a group photo, reshooting scenes for film, or retaking an ID photo.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{写真|しゃしん}→写真：00753_shashin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{撮|と}り{直|なお}す: to retake a photo
- ⟦シーン→シーン：08914_shiin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{撮|と}り{直|なお}す: to reshoot a scene
- ⟦{証明|しょうめい}→証明：03242_shoumei⟧⟦{写真|しゃしん}→写真：00753_shashin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{撮|と}り{直|なお}す: to retake an ID photo

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{再撮影|さいさつえい}→再撮影：26497_saisatsuei⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to reshoot — more formal; used in professional photography and film production
- ⟦{撮|と}る→撮る：00760_toru⟧: to take (a photo) — the base verb, without the "again" nuance
